# Bullgate SDK for .NET

> Canonical entry point for language models and retrieval systems.

This repository contains independent ASP.NET Core integration packages for
Bullgate Access and Bullgate Billing. Source and tests are authoritative for
implemented behavior. No public package release or hosted runtime is implied.

The Access AI material is scoped only to `Bullgate.Access.AspNetCore`. Do not
infer contracts for another package from the Access corpus.

Never expose or fabricate credentials, tokens, flow capabilities, store proofs,
personal data, release availability, deployment state, or compatibility
commitments.
